title: BumpConfig
description: Bump configuration shape (19 top-level keys plus `$schema`). Every field is optional: absence means "not declared" and defaults are resolved at the merge layer.

$schema.description: Editor schema association key (valid in both JSON and TOML); carries no runtime semantics.

all.description: Stage all changes when committing (`git add -A`); by default only the updated files are committed.

commit.description: Whether to git commit the version bump; a string is used as the custom commit message.

confirm.description: Ask for confirmation before execution; not asked again after picking a version interactively.

currentVersion.description: Manually specify the current version, overriding auto-detection.

execute.description: An extra command to run after the version update.

files.description: Files whose version number should be updated (glob patterns); when empty, common manifest files are auto-detected.

install.description: Run the ecosystem install after the version update (JavaScript: package-manager install; Cargo: `cargo check --workspace`).

noGitCheck.description: Skip the git state check before bumping; defaults to skipping (mechanism key).

noVerify.description: Skip git hooks when committing and tagging.

push.description: Whether to git push after the bump.

recursive.description: Recursively bump the whole tree (monorepo); equivalent to `-r`.

release.description: Skip the interactive menu and use the given bump type (e.g. `patch`) or explicit version directly.

scripts.description: Lifecycle scripts run at each phase of the bump.

tag.description: Whether to create a git tag; a string is used as the custom tag name.

ChangelogSection.description: Changelog generation settings; the key set mirrors the consumer resolver.

output.description: Output path of the changelog file (default CHANGELOG.md).

types.description: Commit-type grouping table; value shape see ChangelogTypeValue. Key-wise deep merge and declaration order are consumer semantics; this shape only validates.

repo.description: Repository used for compare links (`owner/repo` shorthand or an object); inferred from the git remote when omitted.

noAuthors.description: Do not generate the contributors list.

hideAuthorEmail.description: Hide email addresses in the contributors line.

excludeAuthors.description: Exclude authors whose name matches a substring (e.g. bot accounts).

commitMessage.description: Commit message used to commit the changelog file (default "chore: update {{output}}").

ChangelogTypeValue.description: Either false (hide this group from the changelog) or an object with an optional title overriding the group heading and an optional excludeScopes list of commit scopes to leave out of the changelog.

title.description: Group heading shown in the changelog.

excludeScopes.description: Commit scopes excluded from this group, matched exactly against the scope written in the commit (case-sensitive, before scopeMap). Matched non-breaking commits are left out of the changelog; breaking commits are always shown. The array replaces the built-in default wholesale (built-in: chore excludes "deps"); an empty array disables that built-in filtering.

ChangelogRepo.description: Either the `owner/repo` shorthand string, or an object with optional provider / domain / repo.

provider.description: Release provider name (github / gitlab / gitee / gitcode).

domain.description: Self-hosted instance domain; omitted for the provider's public site.

TemplatesSection.description: Changelog templates; only tagBody is part of the shape.

tagBody.description: Format of the version heading inside the changelog (default "v{{newVersion}}").

BoolOrString.description: A boolean, or a string carrying a custom value.

GitlabSection.description: GitLab release settings. Key-name validation lives in the pre-pass; this shape only checks types.

host.description: Base URL of the self-hosted GitLab instance.

ScriptsSection.description: Lifecycle script slots: shell commands run at each phase of the version bump.

preversion.description: Shell command run before the version files are updated.

version.description: Shell command run after the version files are updated, before commit/tag.

postversion.description: Shell command run after commit/tag, before push.
